Use this board for an in-class review. The instructor chooses a clue, starts the optional timer, reveals the expected response, and awards or deducts points. Students can answer aloud or discuss in teams; the game does not require accounts or student devices. The 25 clues are new practice questions aligned with the [midterm study guide](midterm-study-guide.qmd), not copies of the exam.

```{=html}
<div id="review-game" class="review-game">
  <div class="game-topline">
    <div>
      <p class="game-kicker">DATABASE DESIGN · REVIEW DAY</p>
      <h2>Jeopardy board</h2>
      <p class="game-status" id="game-status" aria-live="polite"></p>
    </div>
    <div class="game-actions">
      <button type="button" id="game-fullscreen" class="game-secondary">Full screen</button>
      <button type="button" id="game-reset" class="game-secondary">Reset game</button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div id="game-board" class="game-board" aria-label="Jeopardy categories and clues"></div>

  <section class="game-teams" aria-labelledby="teams-heading">
    <div class="game-teams-heading">
      <h3 id="teams-heading">Teams</h3>
      <div class="game-actions">
        <button type="button" id="game-add-team" class="game-secondary">Add team</button>
        <button type="button" id="game-remove-team" class="game-secondary">Remove last team</button>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div id="team-list" class="team-list"></div>
  </section>

  <div id="clue-overlay" class="clue-overlay" hidden>
    <section class="clue-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="clue-heading">
      <div class="clue-header">
        <span id="clue-category"></span>
        <span id="clue-value"></span>
      </div>
      <h2 id="clue-heading">Clue</h2>
      <p id="clue-prompt" class="clue-prompt"></p>
      <div class="clue-timer-row">
        <span id="clue-timer" class="clue-timer" aria-live="off">0:30</span>
        <button type="button" id="timer-toggle" class="game-secondary">Start timer</button>
        <button type="button" id="timer-reset" class="game-secondary">Reset timer</button>
      </div>
      <div id="clue-answer-wrap" class="clue-answer-wrap" hidden>
        <h3>Expected response</h3>
        <p id="clue-answer" class="clue-answer"></p>
        <p id="clue-explanation" class="clue-explanation"></p>
        <div class="clue-scoring">
          <h3>Score this clue</h3>
          <p>Use + for a correct response and − for an incorrect response. Click the same choice again to undo it.</p>
          <div id="clue-team-actions" class="clue-team-actions"></div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="clue-footer">
        <button type="button" id="clue-reveal" class="game-primary">Reveal response</button>
        <button type="button" id="clue-close" class="game-secondary">Back to board</button>
      </div>
    </section>
  </div>
</div>
```

The board saves team names, scores, and played clues in this browser. A played tile can be reopened to review its response or correct its scoring. Use **Reset game** to start a new class session.

Clue topics draw on the [relations and keys activity](activities/week-02-relations-and-keys.qmd), [relational algebra assignment](assignments/assignment-02-relational-algebra-practice.qmd), [SQL joins lab](activities/week-03-query-reasoning-lab.qmd), [table-definition activity](activities/week-04-escape-room-schema.qmd), and [ER relationship activity](activities/week-07-er-relationship-practice.qmd).
